explanation.headline: Paclitaxel is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted 2021-10-05 and is resolved

sentences.text: FDA records show paclitaxel is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, with a prior shortage first posted 2021-10-05 now resolved.
An alternate manufacturer, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, holds a VAI inspection classification dated 2024-03-08.
Corvale East has 6 days of supply on hand for the 50 mL vial, while Corvale General has 26.1 days and Corvale Lakeside has 9.2 days.
The top-ranked action is to transfer 29 vials of the 6 mg/mL 50 mL presentation from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 14 days and leave Corvale General with 17 days.
A secondary option is to transfer 4 vials from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, bringing Corvale Lakeside to 14 days while Corvale General remains at 25 days.
A third option is to purchase from Abraxis BioScience, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: The 6 mg/mL 50 mL vial (NDC 25021025550) used at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside is labeled by Sagent Pharmaceuticals and manufactured at the GLAND plant.
rejected.reason: GLAND is named only as the application's sponsor, not as a manufacturing plant
